pro_course_detail.title: General English Class - Level: Pre-Intermediate
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is based on the outstanding "New English File" from Oxford University Press. These books focus on grammar vocabulary and pronunciation in a way that will get you talking, and that´s what we want!

The full course takes around 150 hours (studying 3 hours a week that will take 1 year). If you feel you need to work on any of the topics separately for revision purposes, that can also be arranged.


After this course students:
--------------------------------------
Can use different tenses in the past and future.
Can talk about possibilities and probabilities.
Can talk about hypothetical situations in the future.
Can compare and contrast more complex ideas.
In meetings can give opinions and make suggestions.
Can understand someone speaking clearly and directly to them.
Can manage telephone conversations about familiar work topics.
Can write basic formal letters and memos.

Word order in Questions

Present continuous
Defining relative clauses
Past simple
Past continuous

Present perfect
Comparatives
Superlatives

The gerund

Improve all aspects of your English, including grammar, vocabulary and the 4 skills (reading, writing, speaking, listening).

I will use lesson plans created for your level, using structured materials like the ones used in language schools.  

You will be given written feedback and homework after each lesson.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A1 (Beginner): In 10 hours, you can learn functions like how to introduce yourself, order food, and ask for directions.

A2 (Elementary): In 10 hours, you can easily talk about your daily routine and hobbies, and make polite requests.

B1 (Intermediate): In 10 hours, you can master conversations about past experiences, express opinions, and write short emails.

During my degree, I specialised in phonology, and I have a deep understanding of the phonological patterns of the English language, as well as extensive knowledge of other languages' phonological systems and how they impact the way you speak in English.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lesson style varies depending on what style of lesson we are having. 

For example, in a speaking practice lesson, I would ask you questions and you would speak for half an hour, and then I will go over corrections using my virtual whiteboard, providing detailed feedback. 

If we are doing a grammar lesson, I will make you use the construction(s) enough such that you have well-memorised them by the end of the lesson. 

For reading, you will read from a sample of text, and we can go through words or constructions that you are not familiar with and find helpful ways for you to understand, memorise and actively use them. I believe that exercises followed by free practice is the best method.
